newsitem.title: INDIA: Japan's Nikkei to sell on-line service in India.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Nikkei to sell on-line service in India.

text.p: Japan's financial information services group Nihon Keizai Shimbun Inc (Nikkei) wants to sell on-line information in English in India, a company official said on Monday.
"We are looking for an agent in India to sell our service, but we are ready to provide it from today," Hideto Onishi of Nikkei's information system department told Reuters.
Onishi, speaking at the 12th Indian Engineering Trade Fair, said the firm aimed to have 10 securities houses and banks in India, some of them Japan-based, as subscribers by the end of 1997.
Nikkei would provide its Nikkei News service, the Nikkei Stock Index service and AFX financial news through its Japanese News and Retrieval package in India, he said.

The on-line financial information package would cost $200 to $400 per month, Onishi said. He said it was already available in the United States -- Nikkei's largest English-language market -- as well as Europe, Malaysia, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Indonesia. He did not provide further details.
